preview_heading: Knight Riders meet Kings in Port of Spain
preview: Trinbago Knight Riders face Saint Lucia Kings in CPL 2026 Match 17 at Queen's Park Oval. The match is scheduled for Wed 26 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The 2025 champions retain a decorated core led by Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein as they pursue another title. Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
